_meta.convention: atan2(dx, -dy) in degrees. Positive = toward target (LEFT in face-on view). Negative = toward trail side (RIGHT in face-on view).
_meta.swing_phase_window: top ± 5 frames (wrist-Y minimum, front 70% of clip)

prior._source: FAULT_VISUAL_STANDARDS.md §4 Reverse Pivot (TPI Level 1/2, Hume 2005, Nesbit 2005)
prior._note: No peer-reviewed angle threshold found. Teaching convention: correct = neutral or slightly trail-side at top (P4). Quantitative range derived from TPI teaching standard, not a published clinical threshold.
prior.correct_description: Spine neutral or slightly toward trail side (right for RH golfer) at backswing top. Head stays at or behind plumb line.
prior.error_description: Upper body leans toward target side at backswing top, reversing weight transfer.
prior.prior_weight: anchor (always active, not averaged into mu directly — sets direction guard)

correct_pool._note: Correct-half samples from same-person paired comparisons. n=1 → single sample dominates. Shoulder-width normalized.

samples.label: correct
samples._note: window values from gate1_tilt_report_v2.md; v2 report records median=-6.8, stable window 28.0~29.4 on LEFT; right median=-6.8. Exact per-frame window not stored in report — re-run gate1_triline_validation.py for raw values.

correct_pool._std_note: n=1, std undefined. Use conservative band width below.

error_reference._note: Error-half samples. Define error magnitude and direction vector.

error_indicator._note: Diff vector: error_half - correct_half. Records the geometric signature of this fault.
error_indicator.interpretation: Each +1 degree toward target at top is 1 degree of reverse-pivot signal. The error half sits +35.9 deg from the correct half for this paired example.

reference_band._derivation: n=1 → correct sample (-6.8°) is the sole data point. Band width conservative: ±12° to guard against false positives given single-sample uncertainty. Prior confirms direction (trail-side is correct). Upper bound rounded to +5° to stay within prior's [−8, +3] range plus noise tolerance.
reference_band.band_width_logic: conservative single-sample: center ± 12° but upper capped at +5° to align with prior directional guard
reference_band.update_rule: On each new confirmed same-person paired sample: add correct_half to correct_pool, recompute mu = mean(all correct samples), band_width shrinks toward ±6° at n=5, ±4° at n=10.

confidence_ledger_thresholds._note: Single-signal Possible; two-signal OR single large deviation = Likely; at-or-beyond paired error = Confirmed.

_self_check.neutral_swing_at_minus_10: Inside band (−10 < −18.8 is false; −10 is inside [−18.8, +5.0]) - no alarm CORRECT
_self_check.slight_target_lean_at_8: Possible (8 > 5.0) - CORRECT (needs second signal before firing)
